home.title: Minecraft Mod Info Mirror
home.tagline: A mirror of Modrinth and CurseForge mod metadata and files for users in mainland China. Same API shape as upstream: swap the domain and you are done.
home.replace_more: Full rules, limits and examples are in the guide
home.how_status_desc: Whether the nine crawl tasks are running, when they last succeeded and when they run next.
home.how_docs_desc: Parameters, responses and try-it-out for every endpoint.
home.how_guide_desc: Replacement rules, cache date semantics, launcher registration and policy.
home.people_pysio: CDN, domain and the file download mirror
home.people_nodes: and everyone who ran an OpenMCIM node
home.notice_1: File downloads may be unstable. Launchers should fall back to the mirror only after the upstream source fails.
home.notice_2: Only Minecraft content is served. Other games on CurseForge are not supported.
home.notice_3: API downloads do not count toward mod author revenue, on the mirror or upstream alike.
